text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! This is where you'll be taking<n>the
Trainer Aptitude Test!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is to refine trainers' abilities,<n>enabling
them to instruct their trainees<n>more effectively. It
is in your best<n>interest to fully commit to this
effort!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: There is a test for every racing distance.So the knowledge and skills required ineach assessment will differ greatly.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That's not all! When you receive high<n>enough
ratings, you shall be permitted<n>to undertake more
challenging tests! No<n>skipping grades here, as I'm
sure you're<n>aware.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Once you manage to pass them all,<n>perhaps you'll
be ready for the most<n>special test of all...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
First things first! Get out there and apply<n>yourself!
Overcome your weaknesses and<n>develop your
strengths.
